. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 2
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var ucdp_nonstate_10      "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_state_10                "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{0}$]" 

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{1}$]"   

. label var g_prec_gpcc                                           "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{2}$]" 

. label var g_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12            "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{3}$]"   

. label var prec_gpcc                                                     "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{4}$]" 

. label var prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12                      "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{5}$]
> "   

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12  {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $outcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }

  2. foreach x2 in  herdXEAp  {
  3. foreach x3 in  n12  {
  4. cap est drop reg*
  5. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  6. 
.                 summ `y'
  7.                 loc ymean = r(mean)
  8.                 loneway `x1' cell
  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
 10.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'             n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'     n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  n1_`x1'_X_`x3'  n1_g_`x1'               ///
>                                         g_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'              g_`x1'_X_`x2'   g_`x1'_X_`x3'   g_`x1'              
>     ///
>                                         `x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'                `x1'_X_`x2'     `x1'_X_`x3'     `x1'                
>     ///
>                                         ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 11.                                 
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 12.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 13.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local ng ""
 15.                 estadd local im ""
 16.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 17.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 18.                 estadd ysumm
 19.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 20.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 21.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 22.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 23.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 24.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 25.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 26.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 27.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 28.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 29.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 30.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 31.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 32.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 33.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 34.         
.                                 }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 5

. 
. label var n1_g_phytomass        "\hspace{15pt} Phytomass"       

. label var n1_g_temp             "\hspace{15pt} Temperature"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist phytomass temp {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }

> ons g_`x1' g_`x1'_X_`x2' `x1' `x1'_X_`x2') order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 10
. **************************************************
. 
. xtset cell year 

Panel variable: cell (strongly balanced)
 Time variable: year, 1985 to 2020
         Delta: 1 unit

. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome   {
  5.                         
. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 summ cy_np_power if tag_ctry_y == 1, det
  8.                 loc p10  = r(p10)
  9.                 loc p90  = r(p90)
 10.                 
.                 label var n1_`x2' "\hspace{15pt} Transhumant Pastoral"
 11.                                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'       n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power         c.n1_g_`x1'#c.lcy_np
> _power      c.n1_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power                ///
>                                 g_`x1'          g_`x1'_X_`x2'                                   ///
>                                 `x1'            `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 12.         
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10'
 13.                                         estadd sca tot_c10 = r(estimate)
 14.                                         estadd sca tot_s10 = r(se)
 15.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10' = 0
 16.                                         estadd local tot_p10 = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")  
 17.

. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{0}$]" 

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234         "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{1}$]"

. label var g_prec_gpcc                                           "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{2}$]" 

. label var g_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234          "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{3}$]"   

. label var prec_gpcc                                                     "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{4}$]" 

. label var prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234            "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{5}$]"   

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn1234 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $outcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }
 37. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10  regucdp_nonstate_10  regacled_all_10 regacled_state_10 regacled_nonstate_10 usin
> g "$output/REP_TABLE_A5.tex", drop( _cons) order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_

. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_jh  `x1'_X_EA_jh    n1_`x1'_X_EA_jh ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_SL     `x1'_X_SL       n1_`x1'_X_SL ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_gods_4      `x1'_X_EA_gods_4        n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_4 ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_gods_5      `x1'_X_EA_gods_5        n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_5 ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.         
.                                 }
 37. 
. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10    regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_A6.tex", drop( _co

  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"

 17.                 estadd local im " "

 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)

 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")

.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 *estadd sca sdi_nwp = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100

 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'

. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 p_energy_X_`x2'         p_energy_X_n1_`x2'      ///
>                                 p_metmin_X_`x2'         p_metmin_X_n1_`x2'      ///
>                                 p_precmet_X_`x2'        p_precmet_X_n1_`x2'     ///
>                                 p_agri_X_`x2'           p_agri_X_n1_`x2'        ///
>                                 year_X_`x2'             year_X_n1_`x2'  ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 * estadd sca sdi_nw = (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 *estadd sca sdi_nwp = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
.                                 }

. foreach x1 of varlist pp_rain      {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12  {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng " "
 17.                 estadd local im " "
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }

. foreach x1 of varlist  pp_r2    {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12  {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng " "
 17.                 estadd local im " "
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }
 37. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10    regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10  using "$output/REP_TABLE_A11.tex", drop
> ( _cons g_`x1' g_`x1'_X_`x2' `x1' `x1'_X_`x2') order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n

> _pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" ///

> $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwnwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" ///

. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

. label var n1_g_temp                                             "\hspace{15pt} Temperature"     

. label var n1_temp_X_herdXEApXn12                        "\hspace{15pt} Temperature $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"       

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12  {
  3. foreach x3 of varlist temp  {
  4. cap est drop reg*
  5. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  6. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  7.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  8.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 n1_`x3'_X_`x2'                          ///
>                                 g_`x3'_X_`x2'                           ///
>                                 n1_g_`x3'       g_`x3'  `x3'_X_`x2'  `x3'       ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  9. 
.                                         lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
 10.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 11.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 12.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 13.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 14.                                         
.                                         lincom n1_`x3'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x3'
 15.                                         estadd sca tot_nwd = r(estimate)
 16.                                         estadd sca stot_nwd = r(se)
 17.                                         test n1_`x3'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x3' = 0
 18.                                         estadd local pvald = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 19.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 20.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 21.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 22.                 estadd local ng " "
 23.                 estadd local im " "
 24.                 estadd local ps " "
 25.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 26.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 27.                 estadd ysumm
 28.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 29.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 30.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 31.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 32.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 33.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 34.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 35.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 36.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 37.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 38.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 39.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 40.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 41.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 42.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 43.                 estadd sca dsdi_nw = r(estimate)
 44.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 45.                 estadd local dnw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 46.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x3'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 47.                 estadd sca dsdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 48.                 test (_b[n1_`x3'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 49.                 estadd local dnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")                
 50.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x3'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 51.                 estadd sca dsdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 52.                 test (_b[n1_`x3'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0

. * A.1
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. cap est drop reg*
  3. foreach y of varlist ucdp_all_10 ucdp2020_num   {
  4.                 
.                 loneway gs_`x1' cell
  5.                 loc gx1sd = r(sd_w)
  6.                 
.                 loneway ds_`x1' cell
  7.                 loc dx1sd = r(sd_w)
  8.                                         
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
 10. 
. reghdfe gs_`y'          c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12           ///
>                                         c.g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                         ///
>                                         c.`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                           ///
>                                         n1_g_`x1'                                                       ///
>                                         g_`x1'                                                  ///
>                                         `x1'                                                            ///
>                                         if seasonal == 1 & AG == 1, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)
 11.         
.                                         estadd local cy "Yes"
 12.                                         estadd local fe "Yes"
 13.                                         estadd local ng " "
 14.                                         estadd local im " "
 15.                                         estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 16.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 17.                                         estadd ysumm
 18.                                         summ gs_`y' if e(sample)
 19.                                         loc ymean = r(mean)     
 20.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 21.                                         estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 22.                                         test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 23.                                         estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 24.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 25.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 26.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 27.                                         estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 28.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1']
>  * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 29.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 30.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'
> ] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 31.                                         estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 32.                                 
.                                         est sto regg`y'
 33.                 
. reghdfe ds_`y'          c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12           ///
>                                         c.g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                         ///
>                                         c.`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                           ///
>                                         n1_g_`x1'                                                       ///
>                                         g_`x1'                                                  ///
>                                         `x1'                                                            ///
>                                         if seasonal == 1 & AG == 1, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)
 34.         
.                                         estadd local cy "Yes"
 35.                                         estadd local fe "Yes"
 36.                                         estadd local ng " "
 37.                                         estadd local im " "
 38.                                         estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 39.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 40.                                         estadd ysumm
 41.                                         summ ds_`y' if e(sample)
 42.                                         loc ymean = r(mean)     
 43.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 44.                                         estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 45.                                         test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `dx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 46.                                         estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 47.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 48.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 49.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 50.                                         estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 51.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1']
>  * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 52.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 53.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'
> ] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 54.                                         estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 55. 
.                                         est sto regd`y'
 56. 
. }

  2. cap est drop reg*

  4.

  5.                 loc gx1sd = r(sd_w)
  6.

  7.                 loc dx1sd = r(sd_w)

  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)

>                                         if seasonal == 1 & AG == 0, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)

 13.                                         estadd local ng " "
 14.                                         estadd local im " "

 16.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 17.                                         estadd ysumm
